description.value: "A lovely eastern schoolteacher faces the frontier with the firm resolve to never marry a rowdy adventurer of the West"--Provided by publisher.

/books/OL3504051M.description:
Nothing in her cultured East Coast upbringing prepared Elizabeth for a teaching position on the Canadian frontier. Yet, despite the constant hardships, she loves the children in her care. Determined to do the best job she can and fighting to survive the harsh land, Elizabeth is surprised to find her heart softening towards a certain member of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police.

Hallmark Channel has released a series off the bestselling Author Janette Oke's books, Canadian West. It is called When Calls The Heart, and there are four seasons available, with the fifth being released for purchase in the fall. They haven't decided yet if they are going to release a six season. The series is awesome, full of heartache, joy, and hardships. You all should really watch it!!! :) The Cast is below:
Erin Krakow: Elizabeth Thatcher
Daniel Lissing: Constable Jack Thornton
Lori Loughlin: Abigail Stanton
